notes.title: Achievement Fix!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

We fixed some issues with Achievements.
The following achievements should trigger when you activate their collectables:
-Awesome Axolotl
-Robo Kitty

The No Death Achievement will now unlock if you play through the game from the first level to the ByteBoss starting from the main menu. We also added an icon to the pause menu that shows whether the achievement can be earned on the current playthrough of the game.
